description: A subtle, rectilinear corner of raised‐field platform with adjoining shallow ditch. In the hillshade it appears as a gentle right‐angle ridge (ca. 120 m on each leg) with plan‐curvature concavity on the inside corner. The NIR band shows slightly elevated moisture retention along the ditch line, and the true‐color image exhibits darker ‘dark earth’ signatures aligned with this feature. No corresponding modern tracks are mapped in OSM.

A gently curving linear ditch or canal trending NW–SE for approximately 800 m. Visible as a low‐relief trough in the slope and curvature derivatives and multi‐azimuth hillshade, with a slight change in vegetation vigor in the visual band and elevated NIR reflectance indicating higher soil moisture. The feature does not align with any modern plantation clearings or roads.
